reviews.title: Really good for the value.
reviews.comment: I recently purchased this monitor, and I must say that I am thoroughly impressed with its performance. One of its standout features is the impressive 165Hz refresh rate, as advertised. This high refresh rate contributes significantly to the overall smoothness of the display, providing a delightful gaming and viewing experience. The build quality of the monitor is another aspect that caught my attention. It doesn't feel cheap or flimsy and instead, it exudes a sense of sturdiness and durability. The design is sleek and modern, adding an aesthetic appeal to my setup. The attention to detail in the construction is evident, making it a visually pleasing addition to any desk. One feature that truly enhances the visual experience is the HDR capability. I found the HDR performance to be excellent, both in games and while watching movies. The colors are vibrant, and the contrast is impressive, adding depth and realism to the content. This feature significantly enhances the overall viewing pleasure, making it a great choice for multimedia enthusiasts. In terms of gaming, the combination of the high refresh rate and HDR support makes this monitor a fantastic choice for gaming enthusiasts. Fast-paced games feel incredibly smooth, and the improved color reproduction adds to the immersive gaming experience. I appreciate the attention given to creating a monitor that not only meets but exceeds expectations when it comes to gaming performance. Considering the performance and features offered, the price of this monitor is quite reasonable. It strikes a good balance between affordability and high-end features, making it a cost-effective choice for users who want a top-notch display without breaking the bank. I would confidently recommend this monitor to anyone looking for a reliable and feature-rich display at an affordable price point. To sum up, the 165Hz refresh rate, robust build quality, impressive HDR performance, and reasonable pricing make this monitor a standout option in its category. It has certainly exceeded my expectations, and I am thoroughly satisfied with my purchase.
reviews.author: Elias

reviews.title: Great Monitor
reviews.comment: I’ve been using this Acer monitor for a while now, and overall I’m very impressed with the quality you get for the price. Build & Setup: Out of the box, setup was quick and straightforward. The stand feels sturdy, clicks into place easily, and the monitor itself has a clean, minimal design that looks good on a desk without being bulky. Bezels are slim, which is great if you’re running a dual-monitor setup. Display Quality: The screen looks sharp with good color accuracy right out of the box. Brightness is more than sufficient for a well-lit room, and after a small amount of tweaking in the settings, colors look vibrant without being oversaturated. Viewing angles are solid with no major color shifting. Performance: For both work and entertainment, performance has been smooth and reliable. Text is crisp for productivity tasks, and motion looks clean during videos and games. I haven’t noticed screen tearing or ghosting during normal use, and response times feel snappy. Ports & Compatibility: The available inputs make it easy to connect to multiple devices (PC, laptop, console), and switching between them is seamless. It worked immediately with no driver issues. Minor Notes: The on-screen menu buttons take a little time to get used to, but once configured, you rarely need to touch them again. Speakers (if included on your model) are serviceable but not a replacement for dedicated audio. Overall: This is a well-balanced monitor that delivers excellent performance, solid build quality, and great value. Whether you’re using it for work, gaming, or general media consumption, it performs consistently and reliably. I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a dependable monitor from a reputable brand.
reviews.author: James

reviews.title: 1080p in 180Hz refresh.  Splendor!
reviews.comment: Bought this for Helldivers 2. Pros:  Beautiful, cost effective.  24", 1080p, 180Hz refresh.  Looks great to me.  Helldivers 2 looks fantastic, glad I upgraded from my 60Hz 22" screen.  has VESA mounts if you need them.  Fraction of the cost of an equal quality 4k gaming screen. Cons: 1. Not 4k. 2. Build quality is flimsy for a monitor.  I can slightly flex it by adjusting the tilt on it, has not damaged the screen.  Despite this, it is good enough to use for the daily, but I wouldn't travel with it unless it was wrapped in bubble wrap and/or a sturdy case. 3. It defaulted to 60Hz refresh out of the box.  Took about 1.5 hours of tweaking over two days to get the settings right.  No real instructions on how to get the 180Hz refresh working properly.  For a few hours I had major ghosting issues, but that was a setting I had over-tweaked.  Once I found the right settings, it has been fantastic.  I may have over-complicated the setup. Thoughts:  Great screen, light duty build.  I'd buy it again.
